A '''stun gun''' was a small handheld<ref name="AotC VD" /> personal defense [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun blaster]]<ref name="Source2nd">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> that only fired incapacitating [[Stun/Legends|stun]] bolts. Stun guns were quieter than normal [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and were used by [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], [[Spy/Legends|spies]], and [[Agent/Legends|agents]] during covert missions.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> Several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] maintained a ban on lethal weapons, but allowed individuals to carry stun guns in their stead.<ref name="TSR" />
